summary: Peak in Lane County, OR, Willamette NF: a 1933 tree-platform lookout, a 1955 tower, dismantled by 1979; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Tree platform with L-5 ground cab (1933), replaced by an L-4 tower (1955)
facts.status_note: Tower gone by 1979 (dismantled and salvaged, per Forest Lookouts); no source describes what remains on the site today
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest

events.note: Tree platform with L-5 ground cab living quarters
Eight miles of road replaced the walk-in trail to the lookout
Cab replaced by a tower; register and firelookout.com say 25 ft, Forest Lookouts says 24 ft
Gone by 1979; Forest Lookouts says dismantled and salvaged

evidence.supports: about 12 miles west of McKenzie Bridge
register administrator is the U.S. Forest Service
first lookout 1933: tree platform and L-5 ground cab
evidence.quote: Starting with a tree platform and L-5 ground cab living quarters in 1933, these were replaced in 1955 with a 25' L-4 tower, which was gone by 1979.

evidence.supports: 1933 tree platform and ground-mounted L-5 cab
evidence.quote: Developed with a tree platform and ground-mounted L-5 cab living quarters in 1933

evidence.supports: September 1933 Eugene Guard item: crew building trail and lookout house
evidence.quote: September 17, 1933: Felix Sparks and a crew are building a trail to Mt. Hagan and building a lookout house on that peak.
Eight miles of road construction replaced the old method of walking into the lookout by trail.

evidence.supports: cab replaced in 1955 by a 25 ft L-4 tower (register)
evidence.quote: these were replaced in 1955 with a 25' L-4 tower
replaced in 1955 with a 25' L-4 tower, which was gone by 1979.
A 24-foot creosote treated timber tower erected, at a cost of $2715.00

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give a 25-foot tower for 1955; the Forest Lookouts history gives 24 feet. The record's 7.3 m matches 24 feet. Left unresolved; facts omit height_m.
firelookout.com's heading R.I.P. 1933-1955 conflicts with its own text (tower gone by 1979) and with the 1979 removal in Forest Lookouts. The story uses 1979.
Hagen in the register and firelookout.com; Hagan in the Forest Lookouts history. The story uses Hagen and notes the other spelling.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three pages, no staffing, fires or current-site description in any source read. Height conflict (24 vs 25 ft) and name spelling (Hagen vs Hagan) are unresolved. The Eugene Guard items are read only as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. The Forest Lookouts heading names Eastern Lane District, Oregon Department of Forestry, where the register says U.S. Forest Service; not used. One web search found nothing specific to this lookout, so none is cited. Budget: 1 search, 6 page reads.
